$Comment:
The woodcutter's kit as a gear set: the four leather pieces the Sawmill's trim work pays out (Lootables/Mmo_Woodcutters_Kit.json) plus the three hatchets as the held member, any one of which completes the kit: the Sawmiller's Hatchet (RPG_Tool_Hatchet_Sawmiller, the RPG Stations item this pack overrides under the same id), the Millwright's and Marn's. The novice cap is not a member. Members are item ids, matched without regard to case. Every tier whose minimums hold applies at once, so the tiers stack: two pieces on anywhere add a little Woodcutting experience; all four armor pieces add more and put the set's look on (Woodcutters_Kit_Set, an effect dedicated to this set); all four plus a hatchet in hand add the most. Held counts the active-hand item only when it is a member that is not also worn, so the third tier needs the hatchet itself in hand. Author Held as 1 or leave it out; 0 is an error. Each of the first three tiers names a Badge, the set's one tile on the buff bar: the tile shown is the badge of the highest tier that holds, so its icon and name follow the kit as it fills (the three Woodcutters_Kit_Badge_* effects, each dedicated to this set).

The stats are the set's own bonus on top of what each piece and hatchet already carries, and they ride the same channels: GatherYield (the shared gathering yield) and the two TrackGain_* stats take their PERCENT as the Amount, and Stamina is Hytale's own maximum stamina. The set's luck is Woodcutting's, so every tier carrying GatherYield binds its stats While MmoToolSkill names Woodcutting: they count only while a tool Woodcutting's skill file lists (a hatchet) is in hand, as Woodcutting's own talents do. A While binds every stat of its tier, so the two-piece and full-kit tiers keep their experience in a tier of their own and put their luck in a bound twin asking the same pieces (the last two tiers, each with its own notice line); the hatchet tier needs a hatchet in hand anyway, so it binds whole. Every entry is Additive on purpose: these channels carry a base of zero, so a Multiplicative-only entry computes nothing. Opening balance, sized so that wearing the whole set adds a modest slice on top of the kit's own stats rather than a second kit; raise or lower an Amount without touching any code. Under Parent the Bonuses list replaces whole, so restate every tier you keep. The text keys are mmoskilltree.lang's gearset.woodcutters_kit.* lines.
